about.headline: A ground-floor two-bedroom with the best patio in the complex.
about.lead: 802 square feet, single level, with a fireplace, central heat and an expanded, sunny patio looking over the pool and the oaks — steps from parking and the laundry. Minutes to Del Monte Center, Highway 1 and 68, Del Monte Beach and downtown Monterey.

features.d: No stairs — the floor plan buyers ask for first.
The largest private outdoor space of any two-bedroom at Golden Oaks.
Living room fireplace; forced-air heat throughout.
Community pool, a large parking lot and on-site laundry facilities.
